prose: A daily tracker lists what one GPU-hour costs to rent across AWS, Azure, RunPod and Vast.ai, by GPU model and provider, since November 2, 2026. It warns that Vast.ai hosts set their own per-GB data charges, sometimes US$30 or more per TB each way, which can outweigh a lower hourly price when moving datasets or weights.
highlights: Daily GPU-hour prices by model and provider
Vast.ai egress fees can exceed US$30/TB
Storage and transfer not in the hourly price
